defaults.note: Default play volume per room. Used by play shortcuts without explicit volume, by play.ts (mode=play), by the agent when authoring new shortcuts, and (p3.21+) as JOIN-VOLUME: any room newly added to a group via Group Speakers / geo Extend / play.ts is reset to its default before the topology change lands. Rooms not listed use volume_fallback.
